recommendation: Keep this focused source fix. No broader FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-5444 unless a future terminology decision replaces or expands the example vaccine-code value set itself.
issue_request: FHIR-5444 was a Published/Persuasive PHER change request from the January 2015 ballot. It objected that the old VaccineType code system lacked needed granularity and requested an example Immunization vaccine value set highlighting multiple international code systems, removal of the old VaccineType value set from the FHIR value-set list, and examples using different codes.
initial_application: Historical commit fc6c7631c4d5ab06ea8d8e6768b857f210769fa2 explicitly referenced #5444 and svn 4396, matching the Jira comment. It added an Immunization vaccine value set containing CVX and Australian ACIR, updated examples with CVX/ACIR-style codes, and excluded the old v3 VaccineType entry. Later commit 4e6d62c69367e6e3fcb59d84d016df913d35607e renamed the same artifact family from vaccineType/vaccinetype to vaccineCode/vaccine-code for FHIR-6128.
additional_context: Immunization is active in source/fhir.ini. ImmunizationRecommendation no longer has an active current-build resource source folder after the immunization split. The current Immunization.vaccineCode definition already describes example coding across multiple systems and granularities, and tools/tx/v3/valuesets.ini keeps VaccineType in the [Exclude] list. No directly relevant Zulip or Confluence evidence was found.
reconciliation: Changed source/immunization/valueset-vaccine-code.xml so the ValueSet.description says the example value set identifies vaccine substances and includes CVX and Australian ACIR. The value set narrative and compose already list those systems; the old description was the remaining current-source mismatch because it still said only "CVX codes."
source_changes: source/immunization/valueset-vaccine-code.xml: updated ValueSet.description from a CVX-only statement to a description matching the CVX and Australian ACIR example compose.

related_jiras.note: Later renamed the same Immunization vaccine artifact family from vaccineType/vaccinetype to vaccineCode/vaccine-code; it is already represented on the combined branch.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive PHER issue asking to replace the inadequate VaccineType value set with an example Immunization vaccine value set that highlights multiple international coding systems and examples.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes that current Immunization vaccine-code metadata should not describe the example value set as CVX-only.
The source/immunization folder is current build scope for deciding and editing this core Immunization issue.

evidence_items.summary: The active vaccine-code value set narrative and compose list USA CVX and Australian ACIR, and this commit updates the description to match those systems.
evidence_items.learned: The edited metadata was the remaining current-source mismatch with the FHIR-5444 decision.

evidence_items.summary: Immunization.vaccineCode is an example-bound CodeableConcept whose comment allows multiple systems and levels of granularity such as SNOMED, CVX, and NDC.
evidence_items.learned: The element definition already carries the issue's main guidance, so only the value-set metadata needed correction.

evidence_items.summary: The current v3 terminology valueset configuration lists VaccineType under [Exclude].
evidence_items.learned: The old v3 VaccineType value set is not in the current v3 value-set publishing list.

evidence_items.summary: The #5444 svn 4396 commit added the new international vaccine value set and example code changes; the later #6128 commit renamed the same artifact family to vaccineCode/vaccine-code.
evidence_items.learned: The issue was historically applied, and current naming differences are explained by a later applied Jira.
